title: 5e-9: review integration — health delta + on-demand biomarkers
description:
## Parent

sutra/83 (5e PRD: health metrics + similarity system)

## What to build

Full health delta section in sutra_review reports, plus on-demand biomarkers that only run at review time.

Health delta: for each file in the diff, compare current health score against the most recent snapshot. Report files that degraded (with which biomarkers triggered) and files that improved. Order in review report: constraint violations → convention deviations → health findings → shape changes → score deltas summary.

On-demand biomarkers (too expensive for parse-time):
- function_hotspot: per-function modification count (from git blame projected onto symbol line ranges) >= repo p80 AND CCN >= 10 or nesting >= 3. Advisory severity.
- code_age_volatility: function with median line age >= 365d that got >= 2 commits in last 30d. Informational severity.

Both require git blame per file, which is I/O-bound. Cache blame results per file with invalidation on commit.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Health delta section in sutra_review output with per-file degradation/improvement
- [ ] Report ordering: constraints → conventions → health → shape changes → score deltas
- [ ] function_hotspot biomarker: blame rollup × complexity, computed at review time
- [ ] code_age_volatility biomarker: dormant code suddenly modified, computed at review time
- [ ] Blame result caching with commit-based invalidation
- [ ] Degraded files highlighted with specific biomarker findings that drove the decline

## Blocked by

- sutra/85 (5e-2: health scoring)
- sutra/91 (5e-7: health snapshots)
- sutra/93 (5e-8: semantic diff)
- sutra/92 (5e-review-2: checkpoint 2 quality gate)"
